analyst_view.overall: Early view: a Paris derby at the top of the table, with leaders PSG on an 11-match winning run in all competitions and Paris FC close behind after a 1-0 win at Auxerre. PSG have been grinding results without Kvaratskhelia (torn ACL), Dembélé and Marquinhos (thigh tears, several weeks each) and Nuno Mendes, and the 1-0 over Troyes was unconvincing. Liam Rosenior's Paris FC like to keep the ball and build from the back, and they knocked PSG out of the Coupe de France last season; team news nearer the day will matter, as Dembélé and Marquinhos could be back by mid-December.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. I lean lower: without Dembélé and Kvaratskhelia PSG have been winning narrowly, Ferran Torres has gone eight games without scoring, and the Troyes win came from one header. Paris FC's patient possession style should also slow the game down rather than open it up.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners. Nothing in the news pushes this either way: PSG will have most of the ball and pin Paris FC back at times, but Rosenior's side try to play through pressure rather than clear long, which keeps the corner count near the usual level.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. I lean higher because this is a city derby between two teams near the top, and Paris FC will spend long spells chasing the ball against PSG's possession, which tends to bring tactical fouls. The referee is not yet known, so this is checked again closer to kick-off.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.8 shots. PSG still create plenty even with their injuries, as they did against Troyes, but Paris FC holding the ball for longer spells could cut into PSG's volume, so I see the two effects roughly cancelling out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: PSG's finishing has been loose without their first-choice forwards, with Torres and Mayulu hitting the woodwork, side netting or missing the target against Troyes. A fit-again Dembélé would change this, so it is one to revisit with team news.
